snippet.title: QBob: Remastered - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming this July 2025, play QBob like you never have before in this modernized version of the 1996 shareware classic with updated graphics, music, sounds and gameplay!
WISHLIST IT ON STEAM TODAY! (Link below)

QBob was originally released back in 1996. I was the artist and composer. I have since "learned to code" and have spent the past year modernizing the entire game from the bottom up. This is not just a new paint job, it's a completely new gaming experience featuring 20 levels of arcade-inspired action!
